scenarios.name: Expand a parent folder that matches browser search

scenario_steps.name: a part with a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
the user opens browser search and enters "origin"
the browser shows Origin as a matching collapsed row
the user expands the matching Origin row
its plane, axis and center-point children are displayed
the child labels appear dimmed while the search remains active
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user clears the query and closes the empty search field
the unfiltered browser tree is displayed
